sync.title: Catalog sync
sync.description: Upload the catalog export to update products in bulk. Nothing is written until you review the changes and apply them.
sync.fileHint: Columns: sourceId (required), name, categorySourceId, categoryName, price. Prices are whole numbers in cents.
sync.changeFile: Drop another file, or click to change
sync.previewError: That file could not be read.
sync.categoriesHint: These are created without a parent. Place them in the tree under Categories afterwards.
sync.renamedCategoriesHint: The file gives these categories a new name. Their place in the tree and their web address stay as they are.
sync.emptiedHint: No products remain in these. The sync never deletes a category — remove them yourself if they are no longer needed.
sync.keptTitle: Kept (added here, not in the file)
sync.keptHint: These products were created in the admin panel, so they are not in the export and are never hidden by a sync.
sync.truncated: Only the first entries are listed; the counts above cover the whole file.
sync.deleteWarning: {count} product(s) will be hidden from the storefront. They stay in the catalog and can be restored.
sync.applyError: These changes could not be applied. Please try again.

mode.fullHint: The file lists every product. Names, prices and categories are updated, new products are added, and products missing from the file can be hidden.
mode.pricesHint: The file only carries prices. Nothing is added, renamed, recategorised or hidden.

option.name: Update product names
option.createMissing: Add products that aren't in the catalog yet
option.updateExisting: Update products that are already in the catalog
option.restoreReturning: Restore hidden products that reappear in the file
option.createCategories: Create categories the file names but the catalog doesn't have
option.authoritative: This file is the complete catalog
option.softDelete: Hide products that are missing from the file
option.softDeleteHint: Only possible for a complete catalog export. Products created here in the admin panel are never hidden this way.

maintenance.heading: Maintenance mode
maintenance.description: While on, the public shop is hidden from visitors and search engines. You stay signed in and can browse it to preview.
maintenance.statusOn: The shop is hidden from visitors.
maintenance.statusOff: The shop is live and visible to everyone.
maintenance.error: Something went wrong changing maintenance mode. Please try again.

tierList.title: Customer tiers
tierList.intro: A tier is a price list. Products carry the base price; a tier only carries the products it prices differently. Customers are put on a tier when their account is approved.
tierList.label: Name
tierList.keyHint: The catalog file addresses this list as a “price:wholesale” column. Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens.
tierList.defaultHint: Every product's own price. Guests, staff and customers without a tier see it.
tierList.empty: No extra price lists yet — every customer sees the base price.
tierList.saveError: This tier could not be saved. Please try again.
tierList.keyInvalid: Use lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, e.g. “wholesale”.
tierList.deleteConfirm: Delete “{name}”? The catalog sync will stop recognising its “price:{key}” column.
